main.description: Output contract of EvolutionValidationCell on levi. Validates an evolution claim against Council attestation records and triggers EvolutionEmissionCell per ADR-2605215200 §1.

claimId.description: UUID of the evolution claim to validate.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent whose level advancement is being validated.

proposedLevel.description: Proposed new karma level for the adherent.

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of evidence records supporting the evolution claim.

claimId.description: UUID of the evolution claim that was validated.

valid.description: Whether the evolution claim passed validation.

attestationCount.description: Number of Council attestations found for this claim.

requiredAttestations.description: Minimum number of attestations required to pass validation.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the validation result.
